title: Five phrases, one stranger
description: Learn five useful phrases in a language you do not speak, then use one of them on someone who actually speaks it. Record the moment you try.

title: Recreate an old photo
description: Find a photograph from at least ten years ago and recreate it as exactly as you can — same angle, same pose, same people if they will play along.

title: Ask someone older what they played
description: Ask someone at least thirty years older than you about a game or tradition from their childhood. Learn it well enough to show it.

title: Build something from three objects
description: Make something genuinely useful using no more than three objects already in the room. Show the objects first, then what they became.

title: Take the stairs all day
description: No lifts or escalators for a whole day. Show the tallest flight you climbed.

title: Run before the sun is up
description: Be running before sunrise. Film the moment the light actually arrives.

title: Cook a dish you were raised on
description: Call whoever taught your family to cook and make one of their dishes with them on the phone. Show the result and the phone call.

title: Walk an hour with no phone
description: Leave your phone behind and walk for an hour somewhere you have never walked. Photograph one thing you noticed, after you get back.

title: Ask a street musician for a request
description: Find someone playing in public, tip them properly, and ask for something they do not usually play.

title: Get somewhere familiar a new way
description: Travel a route you take often, but by a way you have never taken. Show one thing on the new route you had never seen.

title: Draw someone in sixty seconds
description: Ask someone if you may draw them, then do it in sixty seconds. Give them the drawing.

title: Beat yesterday's plank
description: Hold a plank for longer than you did yesterday. Show the timer, both times.

title: Repair instead of replace
description: Fix something you were going to throw away. Show it broken, then working.

title: Thank a teacher who mattered
description: Find a teacher who changed something for you and tell them so, in their language of choice. Show that you sent it.

title: Cook what the vendor recommends
description: Go to a market, ask a vendor what they would cook tonight, buy exactly that, and cook it.

title: Film the sky changing
description: Point a camera at the sky for at least twenty minutes and turn it into something worth watching.

title: Get into cold water
description: Sea, river, or the cold tap. Get all the way in and stay there a minute. Do not do this alone, and do not do it if you have a heart condition.

title: Learn a knot that could matter
description: Learn a bowline, a clove hitch or a figure eight properly, then tie it on camera without looking anything up.
